report.explanation: All observed checkout requests returned 200 with no 502s; the only anomaly is a single 344ms checkout whose client call to order took ~344ms, while other calls were 60-95ms. Current evidence shows no errors and no dependency metrics, so no public cause is substantiated. Need dependency-level latency/error data and a baseline before attributing downstream-latency.
missing_evidence: Per-dependency latency/error metrics for gateway->order calls (simulator_dependency_operations_total returned empty)
Order service server-side latency and error metrics to confirm downstream-latency origin
Baseline p95 for /v1/checkout to determine whether 437ms is anomalous
Trace spans linking the 344ms checkout to the order call vs internal gateway time
